notes.title: This week's update program
notes.content:
Hello!
A new week has come and gone, so here's a short-term update schedule.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mainline [spoiler]2-10[/spoiler] will undergo a rework
[*]Scenario walkthrough modes "Easy Walk" and "Challenging" will be optimized for difficulty.
[*]Experimental: More detailed wave information will be added to try to solve the information cliff issue.
[*]The above updates will not affect the archives.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Chip's certain entries are now always shown as corrupted after they are generated
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*]Working on harmonizing some descriptive terms in chips and talents
[*]Translation plans have been put on hold for now because of the above issues, perhaps translations will be added temporarily via modding
[*]Performance overhead is still not good, trying to figure out how to deal with it.
[/list]

If you have more ideas, feel free to let us know by all means (email is preferred).
Contact e-mail
ashasalorina@foxmail.com

Customer Support
Oblivious

notes.title: 2024.07.05 Weekly update
notes.content:
English announcements are generated by translation tools and may have inaccurate descriptions, please forgive me
[h2] New features [/h2]
[list]
[*] The main level can now be re-entered through the Documents screen
[*] The main story can now be re-viewed through the Documents screen
[/list]

[h2] Quality update [/h2]
[list]
[*] Removes collisions between hall protagonists and NPCS
[*] Main part of the level difficulty optimization
[*] Added an additional wave cue line to the main level
[*] Main Line Chapter 1 adds a teaching level related to "target selection"
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the Boss level in the first episode of the main line
[*] The bandwidth limit for main level 2-6 has been increased from 6 to 7
[*] Added some "Hold the Line" levels: enemies appear in advance when invincible on the field
[*] Optimize holographic projection effect, no longer appear strange colors
[*] Hanelore's active abilities have more color effects
[*] Add the skill name of the Boss skill prompt text, modify some of the text
[*] Changed some background CG art resources
[/list]


[h2] Fault repair [/h2]
[list]
[*] Certain actions will no longer be triggered multiple times within the same scheduling chain
[*] The cooldown of the normal effects of Talent Energy Loop now takes effect correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where a chip entry error reduced defense
[*] Fix [Broken Army] stack logic does not match description issue
[*] Fixed an issue where the entries in the Impasse series did not take effect
[*] Fixed an issue where Bionic unit Passive Ability increased Life cap does not take effect
[*] Fixed an issue where special effects did not appear when the boss was invincible in Chapter 1
[*] Fixed the issue that the main level 3-9 could not generate some waves and the game could not end due to the high output
[*] Fixed the chip drop level of some main level is too low
[*] Autotroopers no longer stubbornly try to attack targets in an unselectable state
[*] Fixed an issue where effects with duration would sometimes end abnormally
[*] Fixed an issue where a fatal exception to effects parameter injection could cause the game to stall
[*] Fixed an issue where some effects would not play correctly in certain situations
[*] Fixed an issue where unstoppable effects do not turn with units
[*] Fixed issues with Hanelore and Vitalia's personal information interface, talents and instructions in wrong order
[/list]

finally
Have a great weekend

notes.title: This week's update program
notes.content:
Hello!
A new week has come and gone, and here is the first short-term update to the program.

[h2]Game Play[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new instructional level will be added before mainline [spoiler]1-8[/spoiler].

[*]The above update will not affect the archive.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Some of the instructional levels do not properly block shortcut key operations.

[h2]Other[/h2]
We are trying to use GPT for basic text translation work, hope all goes well.

If you have more ideas, please feel free to let us know by all means (email is preferred).
Thanks for playing and supporting, and have a nice day.
